stories.title: Onderzoeksraad voor Veiligheid: ‘asielnoodopvang levert structurele onveiligheid voor kinderen op’

en.title: Safety Board: 'asylum emergency shelter creates structural safety risks for children'
en.summary: Children in asylum emergency shelters face prolonged stays and multiple safety hazards due to lack of systematic policy. The Safety Board recommends reducing reliance on emergency facilities and investing in a sustainable shelter system.

stories.title: Onderzoeksraad: 7000 kinderen in asielnoodopvang structureel verwaarloosd

en.title: Safety Board: 7000 children in asylum emergency shelter structurally neglected
en.summary: Approximately 7000 children in asylum emergency shelters are systematically exposed to unsafe conditions threatening their development. The Safety Board urges the asylum minister to improve conditions within six months and establish robust governance.

stories.title: Trump bereidt sancties voor tegen Internationaal Strafhof in Den Haag

en.title: Trump prepares sanctions against International Criminal Court in The Hague
en.summary: The Trump administration is preparing sanctions against the International Criminal Court located in The Hague. These measures would intensify pressure from the United States on the international tribunal.

stories.title: Regering-Trump bereidt sancties voor tegen Internationaal Strafhof in Den Haag

en.title: Trump administration prepares sanctions against International Criminal Court in The Hague
en.summary: The Trump administration is preparing sanctions against the International Criminal Court in The Hague.

stories.title: Partij Merz haalt kiesdrempel in deelstaat niet en ziet extreemrechtse AfD winnen

en.title: Merz's party fails to reach electoral threshold in state and sees far-right AfD win
en.summary: Chancellor Friedrich Merz's CDU party failed to clear the electoral threshold in a German state election for the first time, while the far-right AfD won the most votes in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania.

stories.title: Nederlandse studenten gaan weer meer de grens over, nog niet zo vaak als voor corona

en.title: Dutch students cross border more often again, though not as frequently as before coronavirus
en.summary: Dutch students are increasingly traveling across borders, though participation levels remain below pre-pandemic figures.

stories.title: 'Regering-Trump heeft plannen klaar voor sancties tegen Internationaal Strafhof'

en.title: Trump administration has sanctions plans ready for International Criminal Court
en.summary: The Trump administration has prepared sanctions against the International Criminal Court and plans to announce them soon, according to government sources. Previously, the White House sanctioned individual ICC judges and prosecutors.

stories.title: AfD boekt ook zege in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, CDU mist voor het eerst de kiesdrempel

en.title: AfD wins in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, CDU misses electoral threshold for first time
en.summary: The far-right AfD won a state election in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, while Chancellor Merz's CDU failed to reach the five percent electoral threshold for the first time in its history.

stories.title: Pijnlijk verlies CDU in Duitse deelstaat: voor het eerst kiesdrempel niet gehaald

en.title: Painful CDU loss in German state: fails to reach electoral threshold for first time
en.summary: The CDU received 4.9 percent of votes in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, falling just short of the five percent threshold required for representation, marking the first time the party has failed to gain seats in a state election. This setback further weakens Merz's political position.

stories.title: Grote klap voor het CDU van bondskanselier Merz bij deelstaatverkiezingen - de derde keer in één maand. ‘Een ramp’, zegt hij zelf

en.title: Major blow for Chancellor Merz's CDU in state elections—the third loss in one month. 'A disaster,' he says
en.summary: Chancellor Merz's CDU has now lost three state elections in one month, further weakening his political position, though Merz has ruled out stepping down and is pursuing an aggressive strategy going forward.

stories.title: Regeringspartij van Poetin leidt bij verkiezingen zonder oppositie in Rusland

en.title: Putin's ruling party leads in Russian elections without opposition
en.summary: With roughly 14 percent of votes counted, Putin's United Russia party leads parliamentary elections with 57.5 percent support. Many opposition parties and candidates were barred from participating, limiting genuine competition.

stories.title: Bij Doema-verkiezingen zonder oppositie gaat Kremlinpartij ruim aan kop

en.title: At Duma elections without opposition, Kremlin party leads by wide margin
en.summary: Putin-aligned United Russia is on track to win Russian parliamentary elections decisively with 57.9 percent of votes counted so far. The Communist Party and Liberal Democratic Party trail in second and third place.
